summary: COMPARTNER TELETEKNIKK AS (org. no. 983 401 708) is a private limited company (AS) based in Moss, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2001-05-28. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 46.500 (Engroshandel med informasjons- og kommunikasjonsteknologiutstyr). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 5.4 m and net income was NOK 325 742. CEO: Knut Thams Brevik; board chair: Knut Thams Brevik.
